environment.api: Offline; no credentials entered and no form submitted

observations: From the page, keyboard focus moved through the brand link, Explore button and Login opener; Enter opened the dialog with initial focus in Email.
Forward Tab moved Email → Password → Login → Create account → Close → Email; focus stayed within the modal. Escape closed the dialog and restored focus to the Login opener.
Keyboard activation of Create account switched to the registration form. Focus was on the Login mode switch; Tab moved to Close and then Name, followed by Email, Password and Create account in order.
Escape closed registration and restored focus to the Login opener.
limitations: The CSS viewport was not measured in this reopened-browser observation.
No form was submitted; field validation, screen-reader speech, actual browser zoom/text resizing, mobile hardware and other workflows were not evaluated here.
This is targeted keyboard evidence only and does not change manual checklist outcomes.
